base_branch_rationale: Licensing has no open batch branch; wave A branches from main.

secondary_repositories.purpose: declare the two distributed capabilities in the G4.1 contract and regenerate specs/capabilities/registry.json

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: An entitlement snapshot that names its scope and its node limit, an operator overlay that a scope snapshot can only narrow, node admission that refuses without a verified snapshot bound to the node environment, a free path that never reads a snapshot at all, and the two distributed capability declarations with the registry regenerated deterministically.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing SnapshotLicensingRuntime or any existing capability decision outcome
letting a scope entitlement broaden the operator overlay
reading a snapshot for a capability that is free by default
admitting a node without a verified snapshot bound to its environment
revealing how many nodes are admitted in a refusal
exposing a key id, a signature or any signing material in an explain payload
adding a table or a migration
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/core, larena/storage or any package other than larena/licensing
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing licensing style; no database.
required_tests: an organization entitlement cannot broaden the operator overlay, proven on a capability the operator lacks
the effective node limit is the minimum of the overlay and the scope snapshot
a site snapshot with no organization resolves for a single-site installation
a free capability resolves allowed without reading any snapshot, proven with a snapshot that throws if consulted
node admission refuses without a snapshot, with an inactive snapshot, without the cluster capability, on an environment mismatch and past the node limit, each with its own reason code
a refusal never names the admitted node count unless the limit is the reason
an explain payload carries no key id, signature or expiry of signing material
both distributed capabilities resolve from the registry by the frozen mapping rule with the frozen tiers
smoke_plan: generate:commercial-capabilities --check in larena-specs, and the licensing package gate; there is no database surface to smoke.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen capability id, tier, mapping rule or reason code would have to change
a table or migration would be required
an entitlement would have to be minted or signed
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Declaring the two distributed capabilities ships neither a network transport nor a cluster runtime.
Verification consumes a snapshot; nothing here can mint one.
